headline: Samsung Electronics is 24.8% of the Korean stock market
facts: Samsung Electronics is 24.8% of Korea's entire stock market (KOSPI + KOSDAQ) by market cap.
The two largest — Samsung Electronics and SK hynix — are 44.7% of the market between them.
The top 10 stocks are 57.1% of total market value; the top 57 are about 80%.
KOSPI holds 92.3% of market value across 944 issues; KOSDAQ 7.7% across 1823.
source: Korea Exchange OPEN API (KOSPI + KOSDAQ daily), market cap by issue
caveat: Ratios only — scale-invariant, independent of the price level. Latest trading day.
